description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) static DEX token bytecode scanner that detects blacklist traps (isBlacklisted, setBlacklist), 100% sell-tax modifiers (setTax, setFee), trading freezes (pause), and SELFDESTRUCT opcodes. Fetches live token_address bytecode on chain_id unless bytecode_override (0x hex) is provided for offline execution; returns safe EOA status if bytecode is empty. Returns JSON with is_contract, is_honeypot_suspect (bool), risk_score (0.0-10.0), threat_categories, risk_flags, and recommendation.

bytecode_override.description: Optional raw token runtime bytecode hex string (0x...) for offline analysis

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet)

token_address.description: Hex EVM address of token contract to inspect for honeypot traps

name: check_token_honeypot
